regime_context: US market shows a defensive-to-healthcare leadership tilt over the trailing window, with 'Big Pharma' (rank 2, eligible, breadth 1.0, durability 0.81) as the headline/strongest fully-eligible trend theme. The absolute-trend gate is the only validated edge and is broadly 'on' for most eligible defensive names, but crowding flags are widespread (Big Pharma, Health Care EW, Retail, Staples, Insurance all crowded), and rotation breadth is narrowing. Macro narrative is dominated by AI-tech headlines with very high unscheduled-surprise share, so headline flow is not a reliable trigger.
emerging_watch: Watching Health Care EW (XLV proxy) for a confirmed handoff from Big Pharma (PPH): if XLV's durability_bar crosses above Big Pharma's on the next read while both remain eligible and breadth stays above 0.9, that would retire the watch and confirm the sector-wide healthcare leadership is broadening beyond the headline name.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the strongest fully-eligible trend leg: eligible=true, highest durable breadth (1.0), high durability_bar (0.81, confirming the trend is not just a momentum pop), and Hurst tag 'trend'. The headline ID also points here, which the reader contract treats as a leading/cohesive narrative rather than a buy list. The absolute-trend gate is validated on this market for drawdown control, and this theme passes it. Crowding_z=1.33 (crowded=true) is only a sizing caution, not a fade.
theses.dissent: Crowding is real (crowding_z=1.33, crowded=true) and the detector explicitly warns thematic attention spikes can mark tops; the momentum rank itself has ~0 forward edge, so this is a vol-aware allocation premise, not an alpha call.

falsifier.text: PPH lags SPY by more than 5% before the 30-day check-by date

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Health Care EW (rank 3) mirrors Big Pharma's trend health on a sector basis: eligible=true, breadth 0.95, durability_bar 0.76, Hurst 'trend'. It benefits from the same validated absolute-trend gate in a market where that gate is the one durable edge. Its crowding (crowding_z=1.47) is again a size-down signal, not a short/sell.
theses.dissent: This is essentially a second, highly-correlated expression of the same defensive/healthcare cluster as Big Pharma — concentration risk, plus heavy crowding (XLV is a proxy for more than one theme).

falsifier.text: XLV lags SPY by more than 5% before the 30-day check-by date

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Memory/HBM/Storage (rank 1, score 1.4) is the top momentum/attention rank and the rotation leader. However, the detector is explicit that rank-IC is ~0 and it is NOT eligible (eligible=false) — breadth is 0.0 and durability_bar only 0.35, so the validated trend gate is NOT confirming this. This lean is therefore a low-conviction attention tilt, not a trend-following signal. The macro-narrative backdrop is dominated by AI-tech headlines, which is context but not a per-theme buy trigger.
theses.dissent: The strongest systematic case against: eligible=false and breadth=0.0 mean the one validated edge (absolute-trend gate) does NOT support it, and cross-sectional rank has no forward edge. This is pure attention/focus.

falsifier.text: SMH lags SPY by more than 5% before the 20-day check-by date
